voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: On a November night in 1987, television sets across Chicago flickered.
The local news was interrupted. In its place: a man wearing a rubber mask, his voice distorted.
He spoke for ninety seconds. He laughed. He referenced a fictional news anchor. Then the broadcast returned.
He did it twice that night, on two different stations. The FCC launched the largest manhunt in its history.
No one was ever charged. The mask, the voice, the joke — all remained unidentified.
